name: BENT KNEE SIDE HIP RAISES LEFT
introduce:
Lie on your right side with your elbow down the floor and your knees bent. Place your left hand on your hips. 

Lift your hips up as high as you can, then drop them down without touching the floor. 

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your supporting elbow directly under your shoulder.
Squeeze your obliques when you lift hips.
Inhale when you lower your hips and exhale when you lift up.
You should feel your abs engage.
This exercise helps strengthen your core and oblique muscles.
